SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  DECLARE @LOOKBACKDATETIME DATETIME = ? DECLARE @CURRENTDATETIME DATETIME = GETDATE()  DECLARE @LOOKBACKDATE BIGINT = CONVERT(BIGINT,CONVERT(VARCHAR,@LOOKBACKDATETIME,112)) DECLARE @LOOKBACKTIME BIGINT = CONVERT(BIGINT,REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,@LOOKBACKDATETIME, 8),':',''))  DECLARE @CURRENTDATE BIGINT = CONVERT(BIGINT,CONVERT(VARCHAR,@CURRENTDATETIME,112)) DECLARE @CURRENTTIME BIGINT = CONVERT(BIGINT,REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,@CURRENTDATETIME, 8),':',''))  SELECT DC.CASE_ID,FC.CASE_KEY,DM.SUBSCRIBER_ID + '00' AS MEMBERNUMBER,EFFDATE.DATE + EFFTIME.TIME AS EFF_DT,TERMDATE.DATE + TERMTIME.TIME AS TERM_DT,UPDATEDATE.DATE + UPDATETIME.TIME AS SOURCE_UPDATE_DT,DCS.STATUS_DESC,DCP.PHASE_DESC,DU.LOGIN AS USER_ID,DU.FULL_NAME FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_CASE FC INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_CASE_PHASE] DCP 	ON FC.PHASE_ID=DCP.PHASE_ID 	AND (FC.UPDATE_DATE > @LOOKBACKDATE OR FC.EFF_DATE = @LOOKBACKDATE AND FC.EFF_TIME > @LOOKBACKTIME) 	AND (FC.EFF_DATE < @CURRENTDATE OR FC.EFF_DATE = @CURRENTDATE AND FC.EFF_TIME <= @CURRENTTIME) 	AND (FC.TERM_DATE > @CURRENTDATE OR FC.TERM_DATE = @CURRENTDATE AND FC.TERM_TIME > @CURRENTTIME) INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_STATUS DCS  	ON DCS.STATUS_ID = FC.STATUS_ID INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE TERMDATE ON TERMDATE.DATE_KEY= FC.TERM_DATE INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME TERMTIME ON TERMTIME.TIME_KEY= FC.TERM_TIME INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE EFFDATE ON EFFDATE.DATE_KEY= FC.EFF_DATE INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME EFFTIME ON EFFTIME.TIME_KEY= FC.EFF_TIME INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE UPDATEDATE ON UPDATEDATE.DATE_KEY= FC.UPDATE_DATE INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME UPDATETIME ON UPDATETIME.TIME_KEY= FC.UPDATE_TIME INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE DC 	ON FC.CASE_KEY = DC.CASE_KEY 	AND FC.GROUP_CK = DC.GROUP_CK INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_MEMBER DM  	ON DC.MEME_CK = DM.MEME_CK 	AND DC.GROUP_CK = DM.GROUP_CK INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_USER DU 	ON FC.USER_ID = DU.USER_ID
